title: SII Vol. 9 No. 13 — Basinikonda
location_detail: On A Slab Set Up In A Field West Of The Village, Basinikonda, Madanapalle Taluk, Same District
summary: It refers itself to the reign of the Vaidumba-Maharaja Gandatrinetra

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 14
location_detail: On A Slab Set Up In A Field To The West Of The Same Village
summary: It refers itself to the reign of the Vaidumba king Gandatrinetra and states that when Maharaja and Banarasa attacked Soramadi fort, Nolambi, Dadiga, Rachamalla and Mayindadi who fought against them were overthrown and that a hero died in the battle

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 15
location_detail: On A Slab Set Up In A Field Of The Village Chippili, Close To Chippili-Vempalle Road, Same Taluk And District
summary: This undated record belonging to the reign of Vaidumba king Manujatrinetra registers the death of a certain Padeyyara-Pulikkama in a cattle-raid

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 16 — Aletipalle
location_detail: On The Slab Called The Kattivirappabanda At Aletipalle, Same Taluk And District
summary: This undated inscription records that a certain brave warrior who was the son of Virasatti, a servant of the Baidumba king, fought in the battle of Tiruvala and died, A number of epithets describing his bravery and found in the record
